verdict.rationale: The only credential-related evidence is that Pulumi ESC can act as an OIDC provider, which implies short-lived, federated credentials, and Neo is described as having 'enterprise controls built in'. Neither is documented as scoped or least-privilege credentials issued to an agent. Missing for 10: documented scoped/least-privilege Pulumi Cloud API tokens, role-based scoping of agent credentials, agent-specific credential issuance guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
